scope: Individually read parameter/context propagation and one actual file resource lifecycle; source patch bodies and full original requirements preserved.

tasks.contract: Publish auth/cache/host, retry and timeout options to their respective API consumer fields.
tasks.body:
from tweepy import API
auth=object();cache=object();a=API(auth,cache=cache,host='example.com',retry_count=2,retry_delay=3,timeout=17,wait_on_rate_limit=True)
print(a.host,a.retry_count,a.retry_delay,a.timeout)
assert a.auth is auth and a.cache is cache and a.host=='example.com'
assert (a.retry_count,a.retry_delay,a.timeout,a.wait_on_rate_limit)==(2,3,17,True)

tasks.contract: Keep asynchronous client credentials and return-type configuration in their declared fields.
tasks.body:

a=AsyncBaseClient(bearer_token='B',consumer_key='K',consumer_secret='S',access_token='A',access_token_secret='AS',return_type=dict)
print(a.bearer_token,a.consumer_key)
assert (a.bearer_token,a.consumer_key,a.consumer_secret,a.access_token,a.access_token_secret)==('B','K','S','A','AS')
assert a.return_type is dict

tasks.contract: Store the pagination method and its positional/keyword call specification without cross-wiring.
tasks.body:
from tweepy.cursor import BaseIterator
f=lambda *a,**k:None
i=BaseIterator(f,'arg',count=3)
print(i.args,i.kwargs,i.limit)
assert i.method is f and i.args==('arg',) and i.kwargs=={'count':3} and i.limit>100

tasks.contract: Attach the selected payload metadata while forwarding every original positional argument.
tasks.body:
from tweepy.api import payload
seen=[]
@payload('entry',list=True)
def f(*args,**kwargs):seen.append((args,kwargs));return 7
assert f('x',flag=1)==7
print(seen)
assert seen==[(('x',),{'flag':1,'payload_list':True,'payload_type':'entry'})]

tasks.contract: Forward the original positional and keyword argument channels through the pagination decorator.
tasks.body:
from tweepy.api import pagination
seen=[]
@pagination('cursor')
def f(*args,**kwargs):seen.append((args,kwargs));return 7
assert f('x',count=3)==7
print(seen)
assert seen==[(('x',),{'count':3})]

tasks.contract: Caller clone keyword overrides must take precedence over inherited defaults; copy hygiene alone is not claimed as an ownership defect.
tasks.body:
from pyasn1.type.univ import Integer
from pyasn1.type import tag
a=Integer(7);custom=a.tagSet.tagExplicitly(tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext,tag.tagFormatSimple,3))
b=a.clone(8,tagSet=custom)
print(int(b),b.tagSet)
assert int(b)==8 and b.tagSet==custom and a.tagSet!=custom

from pypinyin.converter import DefaultConverter
with patch('pypinyin.converter.convert_style',return_value='ok') as f:
 assert DefaultConverter()._convert_style('中','zhong',1,True,'fallback')=='ok'

 print(x)

tasks.contract: Bind a registered style to its callable and preserve the wrapper call channels.
tasks.body:
from pypinyin.style import register,_registry
seen=[]
@register(987654)
def f(pinyin,**kwargs):seen.append((pinyin,kwargs));return 'ok'
assert f('zi',flag=1)=='ok'
print(seen)
assert seen==[('zi',{'flag':1})] and _registry[987654] is not None

tasks.contract: Forward original logging call arguments through the configuration wrapper; preserve conditional initialization.
tasks.body:
import logging
from colorlog.wrappers import ensure_configured
from unittest.mock import patch
seen=[]
f=ensure_configured(lambda *a,**k:seen.append((a,k)))
with patch.object(logging.root,'handlers',[]):
 with patch('colorlog.wrappers.basicConfig') as configure:
  f('message',extra='x');configure.assert_called_once_with()
print(seen)
assert seen==[(('message',),{'extra':'x'})]

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from pysnooper.tracer import FileWriter
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
 p=Path(tmp)/'trace.txt';p.write_text('seed');w=FileWriter(str(p),True);w.write('A');w.write('B')
 print(p.read_text(),w.overwrite)
 assert p.read_text()=='AB' and w.overwrite is False
